spoken_script: OpenAI Chief Scientist warns of scaling limits. OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published an essay stating that no AI laboratory has sufficiently solved alignment and monitoring to continue rapid scaling indefinitely. He called for voluntary industry slowdowns and external auditing as models approach recursive self-improvement. Why it matters: This public admission from a leading AI lab suggests a potential shift in industry consensus regarding the safety risks of current development trajectories.
